description: KeepCrypt verifier agreement vectors, public test data: never fund these seeds. Generated by tools/verify/vectorgen.py --write-agreement-vectors from verify.py's verification_run and render; vectorgen.py --selftest regenerates this file and requires byte equality, checks its coverage, each refusal's verdict and each ceremony's seed, seal and insert lines, and re-runs Coldcard's scripts on its dice-only subset (check 13). Each case holds the inputs core's session API takes and the outputs it must give. Inputs are SHA-256 counter mode over public labels, never a PRNG.

spec.encoding: every *_hex value is the exact bytes in lowercase hex; rolls are the ASCII faces in push order; one case per line
spec.streams: every input byte comes from SHA-256 counter mode, never a PRNG: the first `length` bytes of SHA256(label || i as 8 bytes big-endian) for i = 0, 1, 2, ..., concatenated (keepcrypt.json counter_stream), over the ASCII label given; labels are KCE/test/agreement/v1/<case>/<part>
spec.stub: Session::new_with_stub on StubEntropy::Fixed(the label's first `length` bytes), exactly the bytes core reads: 64 OS bytes at commit (mixed only), then the 8-byte nonce n at start_check (the check path, and the first ceremony of a restart). A dice-only ceremony on the skip path reads nothing (length 0)
spec.hwrng: Pi mixed only, else null: the label's first `length` bytes (1,536 to 4,096), which pass the SP 800-90B health tests of keepcrypt.json; the hwrng events hand them to add_hw_samples in order
spec.events: before commit, in order: {kind hwrng, length}: add_hw_samples with the next `length` bytes of the hwrng stream; {kind extra, source, label, length}: add_extra(source, the label's first `length` bytes, 0 to 64), which dice-only mode ignores. Chunk plans, one per Pi mixed case in turn: one chunk; 1,024 + rest; 1,023 + 1 + rest; eight 1-byte chunks + rest; 2 to 6 drawn cuts
spec.rolls: start_dice, then push_roll for each face, then finish. A face is a byte b < 252 of the <case>/rolls stream as b mod 6 + 1; bytes of 252 or more are skipped. undo {after, face}: after the first `after` faces, push_roll(face) and undo_roll; the undone face is not in rolls
spec.path: skip: skip_check. check: start_check, and check_request().url() is expect.check_url; a wrong_go_ahead (go_ahead with its last symbol replaced by the next Crockford value, canonical uppercase with the dash) gives Rejected::Retry with CheckError::WrongCode and the same URL; then reveal(GoAhead::Code(go_ahead)) reaches Ready
spec.first: a restart after a collision, else null: the first ceremony's own stub, hwrng, events and rolls run through start_check and discard(Discard::Collision); its collision report gives expect.collision; then restart_with_stub on the case's stub, and the case's own inputs run with the 99-roll minimum
spec.expect: tools/verify/verify.py's verification_run and render, fed C and D as 16 groups of 4 lowercase hex and the rolls as one line: c_hex and d_hex (null in dice-only mode), entropy_hex (the seed bits: E[0:16] for 12 words, E for 24), words, the seal (seal_code grouped, seal_tag_hex, seal_id, seal_id_braille, lookup_prefix, bucket, grid rows of '#' and '.', colour_index, colour_hex, recheck_url), inserts (one line per word) and register_url; on the check path nonce_hex, check_url and go_ahead (grouped); for a restart, collision (the first ceremony's grouped seal code and register URL); null where a value does not apply
spec.inserts: position, device and device count, sequence 01-12, SeedBook number and word | faces 1-5, each its cell then its letter, '/' and the partner for a mirror-pair letter, '~' on a non-blank fifth face, '--' for a blank face | the word's cells
spec.refusals: expect is core's error and step: TooFewRolls at finish, TooManyRolls at push_roll of roll 257, InvalidRoll at push_roll of the bad face (roll: its 1-based position). verifier is verify.py's verdict: refused (mixed mode outside [50 or 99, 256]: exit 1, no words), input-refused (a face of 0 or 7 in either mode: exit 2, with the field and position), warned (dice-only outside that range: computed with a warning, as Coldcard's scripts compute any count) or diverges (a restart after a collision with 98 rolls for 12 words: core refuses below its 99-roll minimum, which no run can see from C, D and the rolls, and the verifier computes; Q21)
